Indian Rupee Strengthens Against US Dollar

The Indian Rupee saw a significant appreciation against the US Dollar, reaching 93.27 in early trade, with reports indicating a rise of 24 paise. Another report stated the Rupee closed at 93.92, having risen 27 paise. Factors contributing to this strengthening include foreign fund inflows and a decrease in oil prices, which boosted market sentiment.
